title: LoomSurrealSemanticInventoryAndParityContract
clause: Inventory the complete Loom contract after the prerequisite merges and freeze a preservation-first SurrealDB parity map before implementation.

current_source_discovery: Use only the stable main produced after WP-KERNEL-012, WP-1 Multi-Model Orchestration and WP-CKC merge as product-code truth.
Resolve SPEC_CURRENT and inspect all current Loom, Notes, RichDocument, Atelier, CKC, storage, API, native UI, test and migration surfaces.
Classify every legacy SQLite/PostgreSQL behavior, current Surreal behavior, old WP stub requirement and operator-approved capability without copying obsolete physical storage design.
stop_conditions: The three prerequisite work packets are not merged into one stable main.
The official packet/refinement is unsigned or a dependency verdict is not accepted.
Any capability claim lacks a source, test, operator request or historical contract anchor.

scope.summary: Build the authoritative Loom semantic inventory and parity matrix. Loom is Handshake's cross-domain knowledge-linking substrate for IDE and creative-tool workflows; SurrealDB is its only main authority. This MT does not implement future Tailor or Studio features.
forbidden_paths: Product implementation against a pre-merge worktree
New SQLite or PostgreSQL runtime, cache, fixture or fallback path
A new WP stub for this approved WP-017 scope
Future Tailor or Studio feature implementation
acceptance_criteria: A machine-readable matrix maps every verified Loom capability to its current source, schema, API, UI, tests, storage assumptions, preserved behavior and owning MT-382 through MT-398.
The inventory covers blocks, documents, links, backlinks, graph, search, folders, tags, pins, favorites, journals, wiki/transclusion, overlays, media, AI proposals, canvases and collection views.
Every SQLite/PostgreSQL term or adapter is classified as historical-only, removal target or behavior requiring Surreal-native reconstruction; no blind SQL translation is proposed.
Notes/RichDocument, CKC/Atelier, future Tailor and future Studio seams are recorded with explicit authority boundaries and no duplicated mutable source data.
Old stubs are preserved as traced requirement inputs and are not deleted, silently narrowed or treated as current physical implementation authority.
proof_targets: Run a deterministic inventory checker that reports every Loom-related source, migration, route, test and old stub with zero unclassified matches.
Cross-check the matrix against the stable merged main and the operator-approved WP-017 expansion.
Validate that every matrix row has a destination MT, evidence anchor, authority classification and parity verdict.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Inventory contract only; owning UI MTs provide Argus proof.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Private resources remain hidden from another project member without an explicit shared-access relation.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged project, block, source or relation IDs disclose neither content nor existence.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Inventory, graph, index and preview visibility is the intersection of source scopes.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revoked or switched AccessSpace invalidates stale Loom handles and projections.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote source identity never creates a local grant automatically.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Counts, facets, labels, paths, thumbnails, errors and timing do not reveal denied resources.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: inventory run identity, source revision and classification counts
no runtime surface changes in this inventory MT

risk_if_missed: Semantic features lost during SQLite-to-PostgreSQL-to-SurrealDB transitions may be mistaken for intentional scope reduction and never rebuilt.

risks: A polished inventory omits dormant or broken behavior.
A legacy SQL schema is mistaken for semantic authority.
Synthetic tests are mistaken for real module connectivity.
Future-module references expand into unauthorized implementation.
minimum_controls: Requirement-to-MT trace with zero unclassified rows.
Explicit fixture-only boundary for Tailor and Studio.

sources: Official SurrealDB relation and graph-query documentation
Historical Loom migrations and WP stubs
research_provenance.selected_approach: Preservation-first semantic inventory followed by Surreal-native reconstruction through typed repositories and relations.
rejected_options: Feature deletion because current adapters are incomplete
Tailor or Studio implementation inside this MT
